prose: Meta announced new AI tools to detect ads that secretly lead users to child sexual abuse material, and said it took action on 33.2 million pieces of child sexual exploitation content in the first half of 2026, TechCrunch reports.
The excerpt gives the headline figure and the new detection tooling; how the tools work and their accuracy are not described in what was reviewed.
highlights: New AI tools target ads that lead to CSAM
33.2M pieces of child exploitation content actioned in H1 2026
Method and accuracy not in the excerpt
